mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS declining over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE below 6% indicates improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings and valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising together.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle demand surge' regime, rising household spending (HOUST) signals overheating demand, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when HOUST rises in the 'late-cycle demand surge' regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate during a tightening cycle raises discount rates, reducing expected equity returns and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative when FEDFUNDS rise over 60 days in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in UNRATE above 7% signals labor market stress, reducing corporate profitability and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 7%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and demand-side activity (RSAFS) indicates strong economic momentum, boosting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising together.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained rise in the federal funds rate reduces growth expectations, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative when FEDFUNDS rise over 60 days in the tightening cycle.
